files.purpose_and_callers: Legacy Category-specific current-user interface exposes ID, email and authentication status. Symbol search found no active Category handler using it.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: The active command/query path uses BuildingBlocks ICurrentUserContext. The Infrastructure CurrentUserService implements a different BuildingBlocks persistence interface. No privilege is granted by this interface.
files.test_evidence: CreateDeleteCategoryCommandHandlerTests.cs:18–43 exercises the BuildingBlocks context via mock.
files.conclusion: Distinguish three similarly named current-user contracts before changing DI.

files.purpose_and_callers: REST DTO for Category create/update/list and source for gRPC projections.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Requires Id, UserId, Name, Color, DisplayOrder and CreatedAt. Description, Icon and UpdatedAt are nullable. Projection does not make authorization decisions.
files.test_evidence: MappingProfileContractTests.cs:17–33 checks mapping. frontend/src/lib/api-contract.ts has a separate runtime CategorySchema for the list.
files.conclusion: Keep DTO/schema/nullability in sync under INV-API-5.

files.purpose_and_callers: Program registers the Category MediatR assembly, validators, AutoMapper, one domain handler and one integration consumer.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Logging wraps validation and performance. Domain deletion handler is registered and runs via CategoryDbContext after SaveChanges; the consumer subscription itself is in Program. See BE-001 and T05.
files.test_evidence: CategoryValidatorTests.cs:9–74 and CategoryOutboxRepositoryTests.cs:16 onward are source evidence. T05 has separate broker delivery proof.
files.conclusion: CategoryDbContext, handler and outbox registration determine delete atomicity. No additional delete finding.

files.purpose_and_callers: REST POST model and gRPC CreateCategory command. Fields include optional owner and appearance, display order defaults to zero.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: HTTP clears body UserId. gRPC validates the supplied owner, but the handler never reads it. The command has no channel or caller authorization metadata of its own.
files.test_evidence: CategoriesControllerTests.cs:42–64 covers stripping owner. CategoryGrpcServiceTests.cs:128–154 stubs IMediator.
files.conclusion: A cross-entrypoint test is needed to establish the gRPC owner contract.

files.purpose_and_callers: Creates and saves a category, maps it, optionally counts persisted user categories for analytics, then returns Result.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Only ICurrentUserContext.UserId reaches Category.Create. Empty context fails before repository AddAsync. Outer catch maps exceptions to CREATE_FAILED. Analytics count is after save and falls back to int.MaxValue on exceptions. Concurrent first creates can both observe a count above one; analytics is best effort.
files.test_evidence: CreateDeleteCategoryCommandHandlerTests.cs:18–69 asserts payload spoofing resistance and failure mapping with mocks. No gRPC-to-handler test found.
files.conclusion: The gRPC command and handler disagree on owner resolution. Keep HTTP binding authoritative.

files.purpose_and_callers: FluentValidation rules on the Create MediatR command.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Validates name and description widths, optional hex and nonnegative order. Null color defaults in the handler. An empty string passes the optional color rule but is rejected by the domain and mapped to CREATE_FAILED. Owner binding is outside this validator.
files.test_evidence: CategoryValidatorTests.cs:9–40 covers good input and invalid name/description/color. Domain rejection tests are separate.
files.conclusion: Creation requires ownership and domain validation even when invoked without the MediatR pipeline.

files.purpose_and_callers: Request envelope carrying CategoryId from the authorized HTTP DELETE route.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Payload does not carry owner. Handler looks up a tracked nondeleted entity, checks its UserId against ICurrentUserContext, then calls domain Delete. Controller differentiates 403 and 404. gRPC Delete is refused.
files.test_evidence: CategoriesControllerTests.cs:92 onward checks statuses. CreateDeleteCategoryCommandHandlerTests.cs:73 onward checks ownership and soft deletion with mocks.
files.conclusion: BE-001 covers durable outbox and save ordering. Preserve documented responses.

files.purpose_and_callers: Partial update command used by REST PUT. Controller overrides CategoryId from the route.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Null defaults merge omitted and explicit null. Other scalar fields are applied conditionally; a nonempty color takes an appearance path that passes the optional Icon directly, so the omitted icon is cleared.
files.test_evidence: CategoriesControllerTests.cs:67–89 verifies route precedence. UpdateCategoryCommandHandlerTests.cs:18–63 exercises complete and icon-only updates.
files.conclusion: Documented optional appearance fields need a color-only persistence case.

files.purpose_and_callers: Validates route-bound ID, optional name, description, color and order before update.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Null/empty name and color skip their rules and the handler treats them as absent. Description validates length if present. Icon is optional and has no size rule in this validator. No owner decision here.
files.test_evidence: CategoryValidatorTests.cs:43–74 covers invalid fields and a partial update.
files.conclusion: Validator accepts a color-only update and cannot distinguish omitted Icon from explicit null.

files.purpose_and_callers: AutoMapper profile registered by AddCategoryApplication. Maps Category.Order to CategoryDto.DisplayOrder and defines the reverse.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Pure projection. Actual create/update/list paths use the forward map after owner checks; no live reverse-map caller found by symbol search.
files.test_evidence: MappingProfileContractTests.cs:17–33 checks forward values.
files.conclusion: Keep persistence and external display-order naming aligned.

files.purpose_and_callers: GetCategoryById MediatR request used by CategoryGrpcService and tests.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Handler takes explicit UserId or current context, rejects empty owner, and delegates to a read-only SQL predicate scoped by category ID, owner and deletion state. The service-key interceptor authenticates the calling service; the supplied owner is not an end-user principal. RPC Send omits call cancellation.
files.test_evidence: GetCategoryByIdQueryHandlerTests.cs:16–59 and CategoryGrpcServiceTests.cs:56–114 exercise handler and adapter separately.
files.conclusion: Todo production client uses this owner-scoped RPC. Cancellation gap is related to DIST-011.

files.purpose_and_callers: GetUserCategories MediatR request from REST without an explicit owner and from gRPC with a required owner.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Handler falls back to ICurrentUserContext only if no explicit ID was supplied, rejects empty owner, filters nondeleted rows by owner and orders the projection by Order. Equal orders have no explicit tie-break. RPC Send omits call cancellation.
files.test_evidence: GetUserCategoriesQueryHandlerTests.cs:18–99 covers scoping, empty identity, order, and exception mapping with mocks. CategoryGrpcServiceTests.cs:117–124 covers missing RPC owner.
files.conclusion: No unrestricted list route was found. Cancellation gap is related to DIST-011.

files.purpose_and_callers: Application assembly global imports for MediatR, AutoMapper, FluentValidation, shared CQRS and DI/logging.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Compile-time names only. Result and IRepository resolve through shared imports; actual execution boundaries are in DependencyInjection and handlers.
files.test_evidence: Category project source and handler/validator test sources were compared. No build was run.
files.conclusion: No runtime behavior introduced by this file.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category Application project compiles for net10.0 and declares packages and project references.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Explicit references to Domain and the shared Application, Domain and Infrastructure assemblies. Includes dependency-injection extensions for validation. Project file contains no service credentials.
files.test_evidence: Inspected project manifest. Build, restore and dependency vulnerability checks were not rerun.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category aggregate implements creation, updates, ordering, archiving and owner-only soft deletion.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Create rejects empty user, blank/overlong name and invalid hex. SetDisplayOrder rejects negative values. Create and bulk Update assign Order directly; public CQRS validators cover negatives and live Update uses SetDisplayOrder. Delete adds the domain event after MarkAsDeleted. PostgreSQL xmin is configured by CategoryDbContext.
files.test_evidence: CategoryDomainTests.cs:11–107 covers construction, names, owner, colors, ordering, archiving and deletion. No concurrency test was run here.
files.conclusion: The caller must supply an authoritative owner and preserve existing appearance during partial writes. BE-001 tracks durable deletion.

files.purpose_and_callers: Palette and hex validator used by both category command validators.
files.trust_state_errors_concurrency: Accepts predefined entries or exactly # plus six hex digits. No I/O or permission decision. The publicly exposed palette array has no live mutating caller found in the audited service.
files.test_evidence: CategoryDomainTests.cs:143–155 checks predefined/custom colors and nonhex rejection.
files.conclusion: Actual hex validation is narrower than the alphanumeric wording in docs/API.md:703.

files.purpose_and_callers: Category-created domain event record with category/owner/name/default fields.

files.test_evidence: DomainEventContractTests.cs:19 constructs the record. Source search found no live publisher.

files.test_evidence: CategoryDomainTests.cs:88–106 and DomainEventContractTests.cs cover shape/emission by source. Atomicity requires the separate BE-001 PostgreSQL test.
files.conclusion: Links to existing BE-001. No new finding.

files.test_evidence: DomainEventContractTests.cs:20 constructs the record. No live event observed.

new_findings.title: gRPC CreateCategory проверяет owner ID и теряет его при вызове обработчика
new_findings.trigger: Вызвать CreateCategory по gRPC с корректным синтетическим x-service-key и непустым валидным request.UserId, без bearer JWT.
new_findings.impact: Interceptor проверяет только service key. Обработчик получает Guid.Empty из HttpContext, игнорирует командный UserId, домен прерывает создание до INSERT, а адаптер возвращает Internal. Рабочий production caller для create по gRPC не найден.
new_findings.repro: В изолированном Category host с реальным MediatR и временным PostgreSQL вызвать RPC с синтетическим service key и валидным owner без bearer. Проверить текущий Internal и ноль созданных строк. Добавить сравнение с HTTP POST, в котором присланный body UserId игнорируется.
new_findings.fix: Зафиксировать контракт RPC в T04/T07. Для поддерживаемого service-to-service create передавать явно авторизованный owner через отдельный доверенный путь. Если RPC исключён из поддерживаемых вызовов, явный отказ должен быть согласован как изменение контракта.

new_findings.title: Частичное изменение цвета категории стирает существующую иконку
new_findings.trigger: Создать категорию владельца с иконкой, затем выполнить авторизованный PUT с CSRF и единственным полем color.
new_findings.impact: Icon по умолчанию null и UpdateAppearance присваивает его существующей категории. При успешном commit результат и сохранённая запись теряют иконку. Штатный автосейв передаёт оба поля.
new_findings.repro: В изолированном HTTP и PostgreSQL сценарии проверить цвет и иконку в ответе и повторном GET. Отдельные случаи должны различать пропуск icon, отправку новой иконки и явный null согласно согласованной семантике очистки.
new_findings.fix: В T04 сохранить прежнее значение при пропуске icon и отдельно зафиксировать контракт явной очистки. Проверить UI-путь, отправляющий icon, включая null, и не менять остальные optional поля.

limits: Охват включает только 25 manifest paths. Контекстные caller, test и docs traces в счётчик не входят.
SHA-256 вычислены по байтам рабочего дерева. Diff по области READ-035 к указанному снимку пуст.
Значение резервной строки подключения скрыто. Активные env-файлы, secret stores и auth/credentials не загружались.
Build, unit/provider tests, Category host, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Redis и реальный gRPC transport не запускались.
